airport.description: IATA airport code for area mode. Examples: 'ORD', 'LAX', 'JFK', 'LHR', 'DXB'. Searches within radius_deg of the airport.

callsign.description: ICAO airline callsign for callsign mode. Use 3-letter ICAO codes: 'AAL123' (American), 'UAL456' (United), 'DAL789' (Delta), 'SWA101' (Southwest), 'BAW7' (British Airways).

global.description: For callsign mode: search globally instead of CONUS-only. Default false. Set true for international flights.

icao24.description: 6-hex ICAO24 transponder code for icao24 mode. Example: 'a6a7ad' (N-registered US aircraft). Find at planefinder.net or flightaware.com.

lamax.description: Max latitude (north bound) for area mode bounding box. Example: 35.0

lamin.description: Min latitude (south bound) for area mode bounding box. Example: 33.0

limit.description: Max flights to return in area mode. Default 50, max 100.

lomax.description: Max longitude (east bound) for area mode bounding box. Example: -86.0

lomin.description: Min longitude (west bound) for area mode bounding box. Example: -88.0

mode.description: icao24: lookup by transponder hex | callsign: find flight by ICAO callsign | area: all flights near a location

radius_deg.description: Radius in degrees for area mode with airport. Default 0.5 (~30 nmi). Use 0.25 for approach/departure, 1.0 for broader traffic picture.

ai.intuitek.stall/inputSchemaProjection.limitation: inputSchema is the existing runtime Zod projection. Canonical registry constraints are retained here; not_projected constraints are not enforced by that conversion. Structural changes and added schema metadata are reported separately. Declared contracts do not verify outcomes.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.030 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Real-time global flight positions via OpenSky Network ADS-B. icao24 mode: locate any aircraft by its 6-hex transponder code — returns altitude (ft), speed (kts), heading, vertical rate, squawk. callsign mode: find a flight by ICAO callsign (e.g. 'AAL123', 'UAL456') across CONUS or globally. area mode: all flights near an airport (IATA code) or within a lat/lon bounding box — returns up to 50 flights sorted by altitude. No API key. Coverage: US/Europe near-complete, oceans partial.
